        "total_bad = len(bad_reviews_all)\n",
        "total_reviews = len(df_reviews)\n",
        "print(f\"\\n📊 总体情况：\")\n",
        "print(f\"   - 1分差评总数：{total_bad:,} 条\")\n",
        "print(f\"   - 占总评价比例：{total_bad/total_reviews*100:.2f}%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. 主要问题分类\n",
        "print(f\"\\n🔍 主要问题分类（按频率排序）：\")\n",
        "sorted_causes = sorted(cause_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)\n",
        "for cause, count in sorted_causes:\n",
        "    pct = count / total_bad * 100 if total_bad > 0 else 0\n",
        "    print(f\"   - {cause}：{count} 条 ({pct:.1f}%)\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. 高差评品类\n",
        "print(f\"\\n⚠️ 需重点改进的品类（差评率最高）：\")\n",
        "for _, row in bad_category.head(5).iterrows():\n",
        "    print(f\"   - {row['Product_Category_Name']}：差评率 {row['bad_1_rate']}% ({int(row['bad_1_count'])}/{int(row['total_reviews'])} 条)\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. 物流影响\n",
        "if len(shipping_analysis) > 0:\n",
        "    one_star_days = shipping_analysis[shipping_analysis['Review_Score'] == 1]['avg_delivery_days'].values\n",
        "    five_star_days = shipping_analysis[shipping_analysis['Review_Score'] == 5]['avg_delivery_days'].values\n",
        "    if len(one_star_days) > 0 and len(five_star_days) > 0:\n",

        "        print(f\"   - 配送延迟可能导致差评增加 {one_star_days[0] - five_star_days[0]:.1f} 天\")\n",

        "# 5. 行动建议\n",
        "print(f\"\\n💡 行动建议：\")\n",
        "print(f\"   1.【紧急】针对{list(cause_counts.keys())[0]}问题，改进相关流程\")\n",

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from collections import Counter\n",
        "import re\n",
        "\n",
        "# Get all 1-star review texts\n",
        "bad_reviews_all = pd.read_sql_query('''\n",
        "SELECT Review_Comment_Message_En\n",
        "FROM reviews\n",
        "WHERE Review_Score = 1\n",
        "  AND Review_Comment_Message_En IS NOT NULL\n",
        "  AND Review_Comment_Message_En != ''\n",
        "''', conn)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Combine all text\n",
        "all_text = ' '.join(bad_reviews_all['Review_Comment_Message_En'].astype(str))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Common English stop words\n",
        "stop_words = {'the', 'and', 'to', 'of', 'for', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'with', 'by',\n",
        "              'is', 'was', 'are', 'were', 'be', 'been', 'being', 'have', 'has',\n",
        "              'had', 'having', 'do', 'does', 'did', 'doing', 'a', 'an', 'this',\n",
        "              'that', 'these', 'those', 'it', 'they', 'we', 'you', 'he', 'she',\n",
        "              'my', 'your', 'his', 'her', 'its', 'our', 'their', 'not',\n",
        "              'i', 'me', 'my', 'myself', 'we', 'our', 'ours', 'ourselves'}\n",
        "\n",
        "words = re.findall(r'\\b[a-z]{3,}\\b', all_text.lower())\n",
        "filtered_words = [w for w in words if w not in stop_words]\n",
        "word_counts = Counter(filtered_words).most_common(20)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "print(\"TOP 20 KEYWORDS IN 1-STAR REVIEWS:\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "for word, count in word_counts:\n",
        "    print(f\"  {word}: {count} times\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "Zisea2QhTHw5",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "bad_category = pd.read_sql_query('''\n",
        "SELECT\n",
        "    p.Product_Category_Name,\n",
        "    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.Review_Score = 1 THEN 1 END) as bad_1_count,\n",
        "    COUNT(*) as total_reviews,\n",
        "    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN r.Review_Score = 1 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as bad_1_rate\n",
        "FROM products p\n",
        "JOIN order_items i ON p.Product_ID = i.Product_ID\n",
        "JOIN reviews r ON i.Order_ID = r.Order_ID\n",
        "GROUP BY p.Product_Category_Name\n",
        "HAVING total_reviews >= 30\n",
        "ORDER BY bad_1_rate DESC\n",
        "LIMIT 15\n",
        "''', conn)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "print(\"CATEGORIES WITH HIGHEST 1-STAR RATE:\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "print(bad_category.to_string(index=False))"

        "shipping_analysis = pd.read_sql_query('''\n",
        "SELECT\n",
        "    r.Review_Score,\n",
        "    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(o.Order_Delivered_Customer_Date) - JULIANDAY(o.Order_Purchase_Timestamp)), 1) as avg_delivery_days,\n",
        "    COUNT(*) as order_count\n",
        "FROM orders o\n",
        "JOIN reviews r ON o.Order_ID = r.Order_ID\n",
        "WHERE o.Order_Delivered_Customer_Date IS NOT NULL\n",
        "  AND o.Order_Purchase_Timestamp IS NOT NULL\n",
        "GROUP BY r.Review_Score\n",
        "ORDER BY r.Review_Score DESC\n",
        "''', conn)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "print(\"DELIVERY DAYS BY REVIEW SCORE:\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "print(shipping_analysis.to_string(index=False))"

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Define cause categories\n",
        "cause_categories = {\n",
        "    'Product_Quality': ['bad', 'poor', 'terrible', 'awful', 'damage', 'broken', 'defective', 'quality', 'cheap', 'waste'],\n",
        "    'Shipping_Issue': ['late', 'slow', 'delay', 'shipping', 'delivery', 'package', 'arrive', 'shipping'],\n",
        "    'Wrong_Item': ['wrong', 'different', 'size', 'color', 'expect', 'description', 'picture', 'photo'],\n",
        "    'Customer_Service': ['refund', 'return', 'customer service', 'response', 'help', 'support', 'money back'],\n",
        "    'Missing_Parts': ['missing', 'include', 'accessories', 'parts', 'box', 'piece']\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Count causes\n",
        "cause_counts = {cause: 0 for cause in cause_categories}\n",
        "all_messages = bad_reviews_all['Review_Comment_Message_En'].astype(str).str.lower()\n",
        "\n",
        "for cause, keywords in cause_categories.items():\n",
        "    pattern = '|'.join(keywords)\n",
        "    cause_counts[cause] = all_messages.str.contains(pattern, na=False, regex=True).sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "print(\"BAD REVIEW REASONS CLASSIFICATION:\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
        "total = len(bad_reviews_all)\n",
        "for cause, count in sorted(cause_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):\n",
        "    pct = count / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0\n",
        "    print(f\"  {cause}: {count} reviews ({pct:.1f}%)\")"
      ],

        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# 数据\n",
        "reasons = ['Shipping Issue', 'Customer Service', 'Product Quality', 'Wrong Item', 'Missing Parts']\n",
        "counts = [2247, 886, 837, 808, 418]\n",
        "percentages = [31.3, 12.3, 11.7, 11.3, 5.8]\n",
        "colors = ['#FF4444', '#FF8C00', '#FFD700', '#44AA44', '#4488FF']\n",
        "\n",
        "# 创建图表\n",
        "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 左图：条形图\n",
        "bars = ax1.barh(reasons, counts, color=colors)\n",
        "ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Reviews', fontsize=12)\n",
        "ax1.set_title('Bad Reviews by Reason (Score=1)', fontsize=14)\n",
        "ax1.invert_yaxis()\n",
        "for bar, count in zip(bars, counts):\n",
        "    ax1.text(bar.get_width() + 20, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,\n",
        "             str(count), va='center', fontsize=10)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 右图：饼图\n",
        "explode = (0.05, 0, 0, 0, 0)\n",
        "wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(percentages, explode=explode, labels=reasons,\n",
        "                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)\n",
        "ax2.set_title('Bad Reviews Distribution (Score=1)', fontsize=14)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('bad_review_analysis.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ 图表已保存为 bad_review_analysis.png\")\n",
